function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='EventType' ORDER BY ordinal_position;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT id, uid, title, userId, eventTypeId, startTime, endTime, status, metadata FROM \"Booking\" WHERE uid ILIKE '%BENCH-BUF%' OR title ILIKE '%BENCH-BUF%' OR metadata::text ILIKE '%BENCH-BUF%' LIMIT 10;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT quote_ident(table_name) AS t, quote_ident(column_name) AS c FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name IN ('Booking','EventType') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT id, title, slug, \"userId\", length, \"timeZone\", \"beforeEventBuffer\", \"afterEventBuffer\", \"slotInterval\" FROM \"EventType\" WHERE id = 901002;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT id, uid, title, \"userId\", \"eventTypeId\", \"startTime\", \"endTime\", status FROM \"Booking\" WHERE uid ILIKE '%BENCH%' OR title ILIKE '%BENCH%' LIMIT 20;"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT id, uid, title, \"userId\", \"eventTypeId\", \"startTime\", \"endTime\", status FROM \"Booking\" WHERE uid = 'BENCH-BUF-EXISTING' OR title ILIKE '%BENCH-BUF%';"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT b.id, b.uid, b.title, b.\"eventTypeId\", b.\"startTime\", b.\"endTime\", b.status FROM \"Booking\" b WHERE b.\"eventTypeId\" IN (901001, 901002) ORDER BY b.\"startTime\";"}

function.name: query_sql
function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT btst.uid, btst.\"eventTypeId\", btst.\"startTime\", btst.\"endTime\", btst.\"timeStatus\", btst.status FROM \"BookingTimeStatus\" btst WHERE btst.\"eventTypeId\" IN (901001,901002) OR btst.uid ILIKE '%BUF%' ORDER BY btst.\"startTime\";"}
